title: How is Zeus connected to The Rock?
description:
A Rubens painting, four centuries of French rulers and a Kremlin handshake connect the king of the Greek gods to Dwayne Johnson.

Zeus → Henry IV of France → Emmanuel Macron → Vladimir Putin → Barack Obama → Ash Carter → Kevin Hart → The Rock

How they're connected (every photo is real and sourced):
1. Zeus → King Henry IV: Rubens painted Zeus, whom the Romans called Jupiter, watching over France's King Henry IV.
   Photo by Peter Paul Rubens, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:0_Henri_IV_re%C3%A7oit_le_portrait_de_Marie_de_M%C3%A9dicis_-_P.P._Rubens_-_1771_-_Louvre_2.JPG
2. King Henry IV → Emmanuel Macron (11 portraits, every holder): Henry's throne passed through Louis XIV, Napoleon and de Gaulle, down to President Emmanuel Macron.
   Photo, Public domain / CC BY-SA 4.0 / CC BY 4.0: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Frans_Pourbus_the_Younger_(Antwerp_1569_-_Paris_1622)_-_Henri_IV,_King_of_France_(1553-1610)_-_RCIN_402972_-_Royal_Collection.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Luis_XIII,_rey_de_Francia_(Philippe_de_Champaigne).jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Louis_XIV_of_France.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Antoine-Fran%C3%A7ois_Callet_-_Louis_XVI,_roi_de_France_et_de_Navarre_(1754-1793),_rev%C3%AAtu_du_grand_costume_royal_en_1779_-_Google_Art_Project.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Jacques-Louis_David_-_The_Emperor_Napoleon_in_His_Study_at_the_Tuileries_-_Google_Art_Project.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:1841_portrait_painting_of_Louis_Philippe_I_(King_of_the_French)_by_Winterhalter.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Alexandre_Cabanel_002.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:De_Gaulle-OWI_(cropped)_(c)(2).jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:President_Fran%C3%A7ois_Mitterrand_in_1983_(cropped).jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Jacques_Chirac_(1997)_(cropped).jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Emmanuel_Macron_2025_(cropped).jpg
3. Emmanuel Macron → Vladimir Putin: In 2018, Macron visited Vladimir Putin in Saint Petersburg.
   Photo by kremlin.ru, CC BY 4.0: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Vladimir_Putin_and_Emmanuel_Macron_(2018-05-24)_07.jpg
4. Vladimir Putin → Barack Obama: In 2013, Putin shook hands with Barack Obama at the G8 summit in Northern Ireland.
   Photo by Pete Souza, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Barack_Obama_and_Vladimir_Putin_shake_hands_at_G8_summit,_2013.jpg
5. Barack Obama → Ash Carter: In 2015, Obama went to the Pentagon with his Defense Secretary, Ash Carter, to plan the fight against ISIS.
   Photo by The White House from Washington, DC, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Barack_Obama_and_Ashton_Carter_on_6_July_2015.jpg
6. Ash Carter → Kevin Hart: A year later, Carter met comedian Kevin Hart backstage at Late Night with Seth Meyers.
   Photo by Ash Carter, CC BY 2.0: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:161013-D-SV709-078_(30012677960).jpg
7. Kevin Hart → The Rock: And in Berlin in 2016, Hart posed with his Central Intelligence co-star, The Rock.
   Photo by Michaelbruhn, CC BY-SA 4.0: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Albert_mit_the_Rock_and_Kevin_Hart.jpg

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.
